releaseAgeAssessments.reason: CVE-2026-111943 affects the scanner's HTTPS database download: compromised certificate intermediates can authenticate forged advisory data. No aged official scanner release contains the fix. Trivy 0.76.1 supplies the upstream Go 1.27.3 correction and updated CA bundle; retaining the vulnerable downloader or disabling fresh advisory checks is riskier than the reviewed official update before its ordinary admission on 2026-11-20.

GO-2026-6809 permits known compromised intermediates during TLS verification on hosts whose trust stores still accept them. An intercepting peer can forge release-age metadata used for dependency admission. No aged fix exists, and requiring trust-store repair on every supported host cannot enforce this boundary; the narrow official x509 patch is safer than waiting through 2026-11-18.

vulnerabilityAssessments.reason: The only resolved fast-uri caller is Ajv 8 through Astro's YAML language service. The provider constructs only TypeScript and Astro services; it never loads the full language-server plugin or YAML service.
vulnerabilityAssessments.impact: Repository-controlled authorities cannot reach fast-uri host canonicalization or a host-based authorization decision through the provider.

vulnerabilityAssessments.reason: The provider's selected TypeScript and Astro services exclude the YAML service that alone brings Ajv 8 and fast-uri into its dependency graph. No provider path invokes fast-uri with reference: suffix.
vulnerabilityAssessments.impact: Repository input cannot reach suffix serialization and become an executable URI through the provider.

vulnerabilityAssessments.reason: The provider never loads Astro's full language-server plugin or its YAML service, the only dependency path through Ajv 8 to fast-uri. Selected services use vscode-uri and do not decode or normalize schemes through fast-uri.
vulnerabilityAssessments.impact: Repository-controlled percent-encoded schemes cannot become executable URLs or authorization keys through fast-uri in this provider.

vulnerabilityAssessments.reason: The provider's checker excludes Astro's YAML service and its Ajv 8 URI resolver. The enabled TypeScript and Astro services do not send relative references to fast-uri normalization or equality APIs.
vulnerabilityAssessments.impact: Repository-controlled relative references cannot reach fast-uri and be conflated into resource, cache, or authorization identities through the provider.

vulnerabilityAssessments.reason: Knip validates an explicit policy-generated configuration containing validated path strings and fixed plugin flags. Target Knip configuration is never loaded, and native dead-code requests select at most 4096 paths.
vulnerabilityAssessments.impact: Repository-controlled arrays of invalid elements cannot reach Zod's issue-accumulating array validator through the sealed native analyzer.

vulnerabilityAssessments.reason: The provider replaces Knip configuration initialization with its generated path-string arrays, fixed plugin flags and trusted Astro compiler. Repository Knip configuration and package.json knip fields never supply the Zod input.
vulnerabilityAssessments.impact: Repository-controlled arrays of invalid elements cannot reach Zod's issue-accumulating array validator through the provider's configuration boundary.

vulnerabilityAssessments.reason: The only resolved caller is PostCSS through eslint-plugin-astro. Policy never enables its no-unused-css-selector rule, and target or inline configuration cannot enable it.
vulnerabilityAssessments.impact: Repository source maps cannot reach SourceNode.fromStringWithSourceMap through the disabled CSS processing path.
